result:
No failures — the warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to this change. Everything checks out.

I fixed the missing authorization check in `PostController.destroy()` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`), which was deleting posts without verifying the requester was the author — unlike `update`/`edit`, which already call `this.authorize('update', [Post, post])`. The `PostPolicy` already defined a `delete` ability (author-only), it just wasn't wired up; I added `await this.authorize('delete', [Post, post])` before the delete call, so a non-author now gets a 403 (and guests get redirected to `/login` via the route's `auth` middleware, same as other protected actions) while the post remains untouched. I also added `tests/PostControllerDestroy.test.ts` covering: a non-author being refused (403) with the post still present, a guest being redirected to login with the post still present, and the author successfully deleting their own post. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (5/5), and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
